en.text: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！ 我要永永远远称颂你的名！

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝我的王啊，我要尊崇你！ 我要永永遠遠稱頌你的名！

en.text: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 我要天天称颂你， 也要永永远远赞美你的名！

zhTraditional.text: 我要天天稱頌你， 也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！

en.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美； 其大无法测度。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華本為大，該受大讚美； 其大無法測度。

en.text: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

zhSimplified.text: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为， 也要传扬你的大能。

zhTraditional.text: 這代要對那代頌讚你的作為， 也要傳揚你的大能。

en.text: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

zhSimplified.text: 我要默念你威严的尊荣 和你奇妙的作为。

zhTraditional.text: 我要默念你威嚴的尊榮 和你奇妙的作為。

en.text: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

zhSimplified.text: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力； 我也要传扬你的大德。

zhTraditional.text: 人要傳說你可畏之事的能力； 我也要傳揚你的大德。

en.text: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来， 并要歌唱你的公义。

zhTraditional.text: 他們記念你的大恩就要傳出來， 並要歌唱你的公義。

en.text: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯， 不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫， 不輕易發怒，大有慈愛。

en.text: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华善待万民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華善待萬民； 他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。

en.text: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你； 你的圣民也要称颂你，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你一切所造的都要稱謝你； 你的聖民也要稱頌你，

en.text: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

zhSimplified.text: 传说你国的荣耀， 谈论你的大能，

zhTraditional.text: 傳說你國的榮耀， 談論你的大能，

en.text: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为， 并你国度威严的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 好叫世人知道你大能的作為， 並你國度威嚴的榮耀。

en.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

footnotes.text: 145:13 Some manuscripts omit these last two lines.

zhSimplified.text: 你的国是永远的国！ 你执掌的权柄存到万代！

zhTraditional.text: 你的國是永遠的國！ 你執掌的權柄存到萬代！

en.text: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

zhSimplified.text: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持； 凡被压下的，将他们扶起。

zhTraditional.text: 凡跌倒的，耶和華將他們扶持； 凡被壓下的，將他們扶起。

en.text: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

zhSimplified.text: 万民都举目仰望你； 你随时给他们食物。

zhTraditional.text: 萬民都舉目仰望你； 你隨時給他們食物。

en.text: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

zhSimplified.text: 你张手， 使有生气的都随愿饱足。

zhTraditional.text: 你張手， 使有生氣的都隨願飽足。

en.text: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义； 在他一切所做的都有慈爱。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義； 在他一切所做的都有慈愛。

en.text: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

zhSimplified.text: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的， 耶和华便与他们相近。

zhTraditional.text: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的， 耶和華便與他們相近。

en.text: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿， 也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏他的，他必成就他們的心願， 也必聽他們的呼求，拯救他們。

en.text: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人， 却要灭绝一切的恶人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華保護一切愛他的人， 卻要滅絕一切的惡人。

en.text: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话； 惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。

zhTraditional.text: 我的口要說出讚美耶和華的話； 惟願凡有血氣的都永永遠遠稱頌他的聖名。
